item.title: Shindan no Kekka, Sore wa Koi no Yamai Desu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Artemis.
  • 発売日: 2012-04-13
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 診断の結果、それは恋の病です
  • 英語名: Shindan no Kekka, Sore wa Koi no Yamai Desu

あらすじ

Tatsuya is a NEET otaku living in Tokyo. One day Tatsuya and his older sister Rikka, who’s a doctor, travel to a small village in Hokkaido to work at a clinic for a short time. There he meets Nana, a nurse who has likewise come to the clinic as a temp worker.

item.title: Nitou Ou Mono wa Ittou mo Ezu
item.description:

  • ブランド: Artemis.
  • 発売日: 2011-04-17

  • 日本語名: 二刀追うものは一刀も得ず
  • 英語名: Nitou Ou Mono wa Ittou mo Ezu

别名

  • Ni Tou Ou Mono wa Ittou mo Ezu

あらすじ

You are a feudal lord in past Japan. You don’t have a successor yet so lots of girls go crazy about you. They pull down their panties in front of you just so to have the chance to bear the next ruler. Frenzies of raging princesses that compete each other for your seed is a norm around your castle. Reverse rapes are common as well. Yet no one has ever been able to bear your child. No, no one has ever been able to have sex with you… Because you are an impo.

item.title: Siskon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Artemis.
  • 発売日: 2010-08-14
  • スコア: 6.62/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姉婚
  • 英語名: Siskon

别名

  • Ane kon

あらすじ

“Big Sis! Marry me!”

A bold confession of love, 15 years in the making.

“…Yes.”

That confession was rewarded in the most perfect way—with a kiss.

From this moment, the big sister I’ve always loved is now my fiancée.

“Make me happy, okay?”

“I will.”

I clasped her small, mismatched hands tightly and nodded with resolve.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 1998-11-13
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 生贄 満ちる月の惨劇
  • 英語名: Ikenie: Michiru Tsuki no Sangeki

别名

  • 生贄 ～満ちる惨劇の月～

あらすじ

The protagonist is turned into a monster by a demon. The demon tells him that before the night passes, he must hunt humans and sacrifice their souls in order to gain the rights to reincarnate in the next life. The prey are 15 female students and several male staff who are hiding inside the school.
